fixed_schedule.spatial_safety_DAG: a row may be admitted only after its up structural predecessor commits, preserving per-column write order in the 20-position up-line; a selected left parent adds a left dependency. Every selected nonlocal parent additionally consumes one parent-partial read
fixed_schedule.group_policy: the first empty resident slot takes the earliest DAG-ready row; remaining slots select from the first 16 ready rows to maximize exact fusion savings with a resident row, then minimize fused cycles and row index. Earliest prepared resident row is group seed. For primary K2 only, a second resident descriptor becoming ready within two cycles may late-join: before join each bank issues only seed-unique sources, then shared/remaining sources update both destinations. K4 ablation may hold at most two cycles
fixed_schedule.metadata_command_prefetch: a DAG-ready descriptor within the 16-entry selection window may consume the one-command/cycle port before a resident context becomes free; parent/final vectors remain context-bound and cannot be prefetched outside resident storage
fixed_schedule.signed_source_fusion: one source response may update at most K resident destinations with independent add/subtract polarity; K2 is the only admitted dual-destination hardware point

service_model.context_release: a resident context remains occupied through the one-cycle response and is released at response_ready only after its complete 96-lane signed19 vector plus tags has been enqueued in the complete FIFO
service_model.complete_fifo_payload: each entry stores the complete 96-lane signed19 vector in conservative 3-byte-per-lane storage plus explicit tag/control bytes; entries remain live until parent/final commit
service_model.late_final_accumulation: source issue produces a 19-bit tile partial; after response the complete FIFO decouples compute while the final-accumulator port performs its read then write. Final-accumulator reads are not on the source-ready critical path
service_model.cross_timestep_weight_prefetch: tile26 compute overlaps the next timestep tile0 replay, so all ten replays are counted in traffic but only the first tile0 load of an output block is exposed when compute remains longer than 384 cycles
service_model.final_accumulator_residency: timestep-before-tile order keeps exactly one 86,400-byte timestep frame resident across all 27 tiles; tile0 writes, tiles1-26 read/write, and no partial-frame spill or hidden external accumulator backing is permitted
